comparison.objective: Hang a coat, shirt, and child’s hanger on the correctly fitting rack-arm pairs; candidate removes insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Garment/hanger handling, fit selection, and hooking versus rigid micro-tool alignment, hammering, and tiny-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: All three items hang on their fitting arm pairs; no specs or hanging tolerances provided. Candidate requires four fractures with retained inserts and all tangs contained.
comparison.reason: Fit-based hanging of articulated/deformable items is unrelated to impact finishing of threaded inserts.
